claims: Caddies at the 2026 Masters can earn approximately $450,000 for a victory.
The 2026 Masters has a $22.5 million purse.
The winner's share at the 2026 Masters is a record $4.5 million.
Caddies typically receive 10% of the winner's prize.
Caddies typically receive 7% for a top-10 finish.
Caddies typically receive 5% for making the cut.
Caddies generally receive a weekly salary of $2,000–$4,000.
Runner-up caddie at the 2026 Masters (7%): ~$225,000 - $300,000+ based on typical top-10 payouts.
For a 2026 Masters win, the caddie's payout is expected to be between $360,000 and $450,000 depending on the specific agreement.
Winning caddies at the Masters can sometimes keep the traditional white jumpsuit worn during the tournament.
